statement: DRAM market-share leadership is contested rather than settled: cross-check sources show Samsung ahead of SK Hynix on DRAM revenue share as of mid-2026, contradicting an 'SK Hynix overtakes Samsung' framing.
why: Two strong, closely matched memory suppliers competing for HBM qualification keeps memory supply growing and pricing power split, which matters for accelerator input cost and availability.

impact.mechanism: A contested DRAM leadership position sustains competitive capacity investment by both vendors, adding memory supply available to accelerator builds rather than concentrating it with one supplier.

evidence.excerpt: instead show Samsung holding DRAM market-share leadership (Samsung ~38-38.6% vs SK hynix ~29%) as of mid-2026

confidence.basis: Share figures come from cross-check search snippets relayed inside a secondary article, dated mid-2026, and are in explicit tension with the framing of the original lead; no primary market-share report was read.

dispersion: Samsung reported at ~38-38.6% versus SK hynix ~29%; figures dated 2026-06-09 and flagged by the document as conflicting with an unconfirmed 'overtake' claim.
